Good answers, upfront

Before your equipment arrives

Large machinery needs better planning than a parcel. Our equipment specialists coordinate the details with you.

Talk to a specialist

We arrange insured freight to an accessible farm, business or depot address. A coordinator confirms unloading requirements, access width and timing before dispatch.

New machines include a 24-month limited warranty covering eligible manufacturing and component faults. Wear items and routine service parts are excluded.

Qualified buyers can request seasonal or fixed monthly finance plans through participating lenders. Terms vary by equipment, deposit and location.

Unused hand tools may be returned within 30 days. Machinery returns require prior inspection and authorization because delivery, setup and usage affect eligibility.
